structure.unit: Taxes Administered by the Department of Taxation
Accounting, Returns, Procedures for Estates and Trusts

text.section: The return for any deceased individual shall be made and filed by his executor, administrator, or other person charged with his property.
The return for an estate or trust shall be made and filed by the fiduciary.
If two or more fiduciaries are acting jointly, the return may be made by any one of them.
